source_semantics.condition: The direct return lane to LaMelo is visibly open at the right-elbow catch in one lawful permitted window.
source_semantics.bounded_coach_permission: A catch-and-return comparator before any maintained dribble.
source_semantics.observed_action: He returns to LaMelo directly at the catch without a dribble and clears the lane for the next connection.
source_semantics.observed_result: IMMEDIATE_CATCH_RETURN_AND_REENGAGEMENT; no shot, assist, score, or possession finish selected.
source_semantics.cost: He gives up a personal short-attack chance while LaMelo takes the next decision.

source_semantics.condition: A lawful, separately permitted NBA game window has Protagonist and LaMelo on court; first return lane closes at the catch.
source_semantics.bounded_coach_permission: One short-angle response trial, with transition-defense responsibility if the pass fails.
source_semantics.observed_action: He holds the dribble to alter the angle, releases late into the blocked first route, loses the ball, and turns to recover his assigned defensive lane.
source_semantics.observed_result: TURNOVER_AND_RECOVERY_ATTEMPT; no opponent score or possession end selected.
source_semantics.cost: His lost attacking opportunity and the teammate relocation/transition burden stay in the sample.

source_semantics.condition: A later lawful window again closes the direct top-of-arc route; Protagonist sees a different rear-angle reset lane to the nearby LaMelo.
source_semantics.bounded_coach_permission: Retry once and stop forcing the angle when the return is closed.
source_semantics.observed_action: He starts the short dribble, sees the direct top route stay closed, stops that pass, observes the separate rear-angle lane open, returns through it to LaMelo, then changes position for another connection.
source_semantics.observed_result: SAFE_RESET_AND_REENGAGEMENT; no made basket, assist, possession finish, or repeated success awarded.
source_semantics.cost: Own shot/creation time is surrendered and the team still spends attack clock.

source_semantics.condition: The already prepared short inside step is briefly available before the defender closes the path.
source_semantics.bounded_coach_permission: One short-action comparison only, not a permanent joint-ace or closing assignment.
source_semantics.observed_action: He takes the prepared short step while the opening is visible, sees the inside path close, and stops rather than adding an unprepared advanced move.
source_semantics.observed_result: OWN_BOUNDED_ATTEMPT_AND_STOP; shot, points, assist and possession finish remain unselected.
source_semantics.cost: He uses a limited attacking window without earning a scoring result or repeatable creator role.

source_semantics.condition: In a separate window LaMelo or LaVine has a visibly faster available route than Protagonist.
source_semantics.bounded_coach_permission: Compare the teammate advantage and retain rebound/reconnection responsibility.
source_semantics.observed_action: He passes to the observed better-positioned teammate, moves to the rebound/reconnection lane, and retains responsibility for the result.
source_semantics.observed_result: TEAMMATE_ADVANTAGE_HANDOFF_AND_REENGAGEMENT_ONLY; teammate finish, score, assist and game authority remain unselected.
source_semantics.cost: He relinquishes a personal attempt; the teammate accepts a bounded new decision burden.
